words: Tonight's 20 Tier 3 and Tier V players with the highest deposits who are winning today. Fewer than 20 winners: fill down the ranking to 20.
The player's result in the export. Above 0 means the player is winning today: keep them. Below 0 means losing: skip, Top PNL and LTV cover them.
Greeting, real interaction and looking after the player. Relationship, not sales.
An Internal Message and a Push notification, sent at the same time from the BO.
The tag for a top depositor you engaged.
The backend system where you check and update player details.

tour.label: When
tour.title: Is this player in tonight's Top 20?
items: Among the highest deposits today (export from 8:30 PM)
tour.done: All three: send VIP care, no bonus.
tour.notYet: A losing player is skipped here. Top PNL and LTV look after them.

tour.label: Do
tour.title: Six steps, night shift 8:30 PM
items: Reuse the Top P&L export if you have it. Wait for the full load.
CS SORTING FILE: deposit highest first, Total Win/Loss above 0, Tier 3 and Tier V.
Top 20 into Customer Approaching File, TOP 20 Depositor (Night). Fewer than 20: fill down.
Send both at the same time: greeting, interaction, VIP care. No bonus, no SMS.
If they reply, talk on Livechat or Telegram. Tag Deposit Engaged.

tour.label: Never
tour.title: Four hard stops
items: Mention a bonus or send an SMS to a top depositor.
Add a losing player to the Top 20. They belong to Top PNL and LTV.
Turn the chat into a sales push. This is care, not selling.
Handle a complaint with Top Deposit logic. Use the Complaint Handling SOP.

tour.label: Read the player
tour.title: Before you message, look at the player
tour.done: Use what you saw to make the greeting personal.
tour.notYet: Check all three. They shape how you talk to the player, not whether you send.

tour.label: Bonus?
tour.title: Can a top depositor ever get a bonus?
tour.q: Is the player asking for a bonus?
tour.yes: Still no bonus. Top depositors are winning players in profit, so a bonus makes no sense. Explain kindly and keep the talk on VIP care.
tour.no: Engagement only: greeting, interaction, VIP care. No bonus.

pool.q: A player has the 3rd highest deposit tonight but is losing today. What do you do?
o: Skip them; Top PNL and LTV cover losing players
pool.why: Top Deposit targets winning players only. Losing players are handled under Top PNL and LTV.

pool.q: Which channels do you use for the Top 20?
o: IM + Push, at the same time
pool.why: Internal Message and Push, sent simultaneously. No SMS.

pool.q: A top depositor asks what bonus they get tonight. What do you say?
o: Talk care and interaction; this task gives no bonus
pool.why: Top Deposit is engagement only: greeting, interaction, VIP care. No bonus messaging.

pool.q: Only 14 Tier 3 and Tier V players are winning tonight. How many do you message?
pool.why: If fewer than 20 winners, fill down the ranking to 20.

pool.q: In the export, a player's Total Win/Loss is RM -2,500. Keep or skip?
pool.why: Keep only Total Win/Loss above 0 (winning). Below 0 is losing: skip.

pool.q: During a Top Deposit chat, the player starts complaining. What now?
o: Offer a bonus to calm them
Switch to the Complaint Handling SOP
pool.why: A complaint during engagement goes to the Complaint Handling SOP, not Top Deposit logic.
Night shift, daily at 8:30 PM. Reuse the Top P&L export if available.

pool.q: You engaged a top depositor on Livechat. What do you tag?
pool.why: Tag Deposit Engaged, then update the QA Record with a screenshot.
